answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 35479 Country: India Title: Can you please give me some good duas to increase memory power of my child so that she can remember Quran duas and school studies? I want her to get good memory Question: Can you please give me some good duas to increase memory power of my child so that she can remember Quran duas and school studies? I want her to get good memory. Please help with duas for, where I can read it and blow in water and give her to drink. Please note that we are converts still in learning phase. Answer ID: 35479 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1865/1318/L=1432) Recite Surah Alam Nashrah seven times and blow it on water and give it to drink. In-sha-Allah her memory power shall increase. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
